response.rationale: Both answers are correct for the stated baby-care sense. Popok is the ordinary Indonesian term, while lampin is the standard Malay term, including for diapers. The different-common-word relation is appropriate as a national-preference contrast, though not exclusive. No false-friend issue is present; lampin can additionally refer to cloth wrapping, but that does not invalidate the diaper sense.
